description: Authorises this domain to send authenticated transactional email through OVEYON on its e-mailbox.com sending infrastructure. Publishes three DKIM aliases, the two return-path aliases that carry bounces and align the envelope sender, and merges the e-mailbox.com sending infrastructure into the domain's SPF record.
variableDescription: %dcode%: the numeric identifier OVEYON assigns to this domain. It is the suffix of the two return-path labels, so they cannot collide with anything already on the zone.
